title: No privacy policy
body: The website has a Google Analytics tracker, but there is no privacy policy, so it is in breach of section 7 of the Google Analytics TOS (which requires disclosure of this tracker).
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
>You must post a Privacy Policy and that Privacy Policy must provide notice of Your use of cookies that are used to collect data. 

We configure Google Analytics into "non-cookie" mode and feed it a false user fingerprint and tell analytics not to even store the IP. We therefore don't have any notice of cookies to provide as we don't use em ;)

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
I do believe it is still required according to the Google Analytics TOS, which specifically says in section 7 it must be disclosed.

And I didn't even mention what Google Chrome says in the address bar now (and turns red when you enter text).

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: Why not simply remove google analytics if we do not use it? Would that make it harder for possible users to find kicad? (Meaning would google reduce the rating of the kicad website?)

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
